home.description: Left-rail Library selected, showing the Your Library overview with collections, search/view/sort controls, New Draft, and project cards.

nodes.title: Agent model
nodes.notes: Default for new agent chats.

nodes.title: Agent effort
nodes.notes: Default for new agent chats.

nodes.title: Custom window sizes
nodes.notes: Rows define recording window-size presets.

nodes.title: Add Size
nodes.notes: Appends a Custom N row defaulting to 1440x897.

nodes.title: Remove
nodes.notes: Deletes the corresponding preset row; destructive action was not operated.

nodes.title: New Routine editor
nodes.notes: Create/edit API-driven automated video generation routines.

nodes.title: Add Routine
nodes.notes: Enabled after name and agent instructions are non-empty.

nodes.title: Routine detail
nodes.notes: Editable settings plus API run endpoint and request example.

nodes.title: Save Changes
nodes.notes: Appears when routine edits are pending.

nodes.title: Select a project
nodes.notes: Visible only when Start from a project is enabled; choose an existing project, then Save Changes.

nodes.title: Template Editor
nodes.notes: Scratch created: Grounding Scratch Template Chapter 3.

nodes.title: Effort
nodes.notes: Per-template editor agent effort; default observed High.

nodes.title: Performance Mode
nodes.notes: Template-scoped within the selected brand template; choice applies immediately and closes the menu.

nodes.title: Layout notes
nodes.notes: Single text area; no separate save button visible.

nodes.title: Misc notes
nodes.notes: Single text area; no separate save button visible.

nodes.title: Draft project editor
nodes.notes: Full editor opened from a draft; left Agent/Script panel, central preview/timeline, top status controls.

nodes.title: Type script or # for new scene
Captions visibility
nodes.notes: Direct icon toggle; no settings panel opened.

nodes.title: Talking Speed
nodes.notes: Bottom of voice picker; selection applies immediately and changes label, e.g. Fast Talking Speed.

nodes.title: World Voices
nodes.notes: Localized voice list in the voice picker.

nodes.title: Creative Voices
nodes.notes: Character-style voice list.

nodes.title: Media Gen Mode
nodes.notes: Open Composer actions > Switch to Media Gen; shows model/credit selector such as Multi 21 cr.

nodes.title: Image Models and Quantities
nodes.notes: Four quantity dots per model; combined choice shown with credit cost.

nodes.title: Save as default
nodes.notes: Persists the current generation model/layout selection as default.

nodes.title: Generate Video model picker
nodes.notes: Video mode picker; lists Kling-2.5, Sora-2 Pro, Veo-3.1 with quantity dots.

nodes.title: Add Music popover
nodes.notes: Offers upload of one background track; MP3/WAV/M4A.

nodes.title: Upload background track
nodes.notes: Opens local file chooser; accepts MP3, WAV, M4A.

nodes.title: Composition color
nodes.notes: Solid editor includes hue, opacity, eyedropper, hex and format switch.

nodes.title: Brand assignment
nodes.notes: Project actions > Brand; nested chooser also has Edit Brands…

nodes.title: Overlay template picker
nodes.notes: Opened from the overlay-slide icon above timeline; lists assigned-brand templates and New Blank Overlay.

nodes.title: Overlay editor
nodes.notes: Entered after creating/selecting an overlay clip.

nodes.title: New Blank Overlay
nodes.notes: Creates a 4-second Overlay timeline clip.

nodes.title: Insert
nodes.notes: Overlay element menu.

nodes.title: Highlight, stroke, shadow, blur and motion blur
New in Collection
nodes.notes: Immediately creates an empty draft in the current collection and opens the standard draft editor.

nodes.title: Collection-created draft editor
nodes.notes: Same standard draft editor, reached by New in Collection; scratch created as Untitled.

nodes.title: New workspace
nodes.notes: Account/workspace creation action.

nodes.title: Model selector
nodes.notes: Visible when Demo mode is Off; shown as Model: Fable 5.

nodes.title: Dev
nodes.notes: Top-right popup visible when Demo mode is Off.

nodes.title: Developer Inspector
nodes.notes: Available only when Demo mode is Off; exposes authored/resolved node JSON, transcript PM doc, and collab diagnostics.

nodes.title: Library sort order
nodes.notes: Selection applies immediately and closes the popover.

nodes.title: Make a copy
nodes.notes: Immediately creates and opens “Copy of <name>”.

nodes.title: Canvas Size
nodes.notes: Immediate apply; menu closes.

nodes.title: Project Dev options
nodes.notes: Visible with Demo mode Off.

nodes.title: Copy Transcript
nodes.notes: Copies transcript to clipboard; no visible confirmation.

nodes.title: Download SRT...
nodes.notes: Likely local save/download; harness blocks operation as destructive.

nodes.title: Labels
nodes.notes: Demo mode Off only; immediate toggle adds internal component labels.

nodes.title: Messages
nodes.notes: Demo mode Off only; immediate toggle.

nodes.title: Copy Project ID
nodes.notes: Demo mode Off only; copies to clipboard with no visible confirmation.

nodes.title: Add Reference File Chooser
nodes.notes: Standard macOS Open sheet; Cancel safe.

nodes.title: Duplicated Template
nodes.notes: Immediate duplicate of current template, named '<original> Copy'.

nodes.title: Search
nodes.notes: Library header text field filters library content.

edges.action: click "Your Drafts" in the left sidebar
click "Brand Kits" at the bottom of the left sidebar
click "Settings" at the bottom of the left sidebar
Settings modal opens at Preferences; scroll down for other sections
scroll down in the right side of the Settings modal
click Your Drafts in left rail
enter name and Agent instructions, then click Add Routine
click “Brand Kits” in the left rail
fill Name and Prompt, click “Done”, then click page-level “Save Changes”
click a background swatch or Add Background
click a text color swatch or Add Text Color
click Edit Style on a row
click “Layout” in Brand Studio side menu
click “Misc” in Brand Studio side menu
open a draft card or click its draft shortcut in the left rail
click “Project actions” ellipsis, then “Screen Clip Settings...”
click model/credit popup, e.g. Multi 21 cr
switch composer to Video, then click the compact model/credit popup
click Add Music in top-right status bar
click Open paint picker in top-right status bar
click “See All” in the Text inspector
enter a name, optionally choose a color, then click “Create Collection”
click the workspace-name badge at top of left rail
Turn Demo mode Off in workspace switcher, click Dev, then Show Inspector.
click the unlabeled sort-order icon beside Grid/List
open Project actions and click “Make a copy”
open Project actions and choose an aspect ratio
open Project actions and choose Efficiency, Default, or Ultra
